files.description: Read for any Svelte UI change — components, runes, state factories, and CSS tokens.
Read when the diff composes UI from shadcn-svelte components — the compose-first norm, the token bridge, the icon swap, and what stays custom.
Read only when the diff adds or works with a vendored icon.
Read for TypeScript module shape — dependency injection, file-split seams, zod boundaries, helpers, and the @/ import aliases.
Read when the diff adds or changes a @core/* import — the node-free invariant a shared module owes the browser bundle.
Read when the diff touches ui/src/lib/log.ts — the uiLog batch path and the censor list a new redaction key must reach.
Read when the diff tests browser behavior — the e2e versus unit split, and the e2e harness.
